title: Ether, Accounts, and Contract Interactions
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Ether, Accounts, and Contract Interactions and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 11: Ether, Accounts, and Contract Interactions; it lists all 15 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 11 roadmap: The msg Global Object; The block and tx Global Objects; The address Type and Address Utilities; Payable Functions and Constructors; Receiving Ether with receive(); Fallback Functions; Sending Ether and Handling Failures; Understanding call , staticcall , and delegatecall; Low-Level Calls and Return-Value Handling; Contract-to-Contract Communication; Contract Creation with new; Creating Contracts with CREATE and CREATE2; ETH Balances and Forced ETH Transfers; Handling Untrusted External Contracts; Transaction Call Context and Trust Boundaries. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
